mathgap.title: Directed More-Than Interpretation
mathgap.principle: Translate comparative statements of the form 'A has N more (or fewer) items than B' into the equation A = B + N (or A = B - N).
mathgap.when_to_apply: Whenever a statement explicitly says one person has more or fewer items than another.
mathgap.example: Interpreting 'A has 5 more items than B' as A = B + 5, but mistakenly treating it as A = |B + 5|.

mathgap.title: Immediate Direct Assignment Update
mathgap.principle: A direct count statement (e.g., 'A has N items') sets the current value of A to N at that point in the narrative, and later transfers can modify it.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When encountering a sentence that gives an explicit number of items for a person.
mathgap.example: Setting A = 5 from 'A has 5 items', but incorrectly treating it as a permanent value that cannot change later.

mathgap.title: Temporal Consistency of Transfers and Relational Statements
mathgap.principle: Process the problem sequentially; when a transfer ('X gives N to Y') appears, immediately subtract N from X and add N to Y, and any subsequent relational statements refer to these updated counts.
mathgap.when_to_apply: Whenever a transfer statement is encountered, and for any relational statement that follows it.
mathgap.example: Applying a transfer after all relational constraints, leading to wrong values, instead of updating counts immediately.

mathgap.title: Full Difference Equality Interpretation
mathgap.principle: For sentences equating two differences, translate them into the form (A - B) = (C - D), preserving the order of names on each side and treating the differences as signed.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When a statement says 'the number of X that ... is equal to the difference between the number of Y and Z'.
mathgap.example: Misreading 'A - B = C - D' as 'A = B + C - D' (ignoring the signed nature of the left side).

mathgap.title: Quantity Modification (Multiplication and Subtraction)
mathgap.principle: When a statement modifies a count by multiplication, division, or subtraction (e.g., 'X increases by 3 times'), apply the appropriate arithmetic operation to the current value of X.
mathgap.when_to_apply: Whenever a phrase like 'increases by N times' or 'decreases by N' appears.
mathgap.example: Treating 'increases by 3 times' as adding 3 instead of multiplying by 3.

mathgap.title: Redistribute Equally Among Group
mathgap.principle: If a group of people redistributes their items so that each ends up with the same amount, compute the total items among them and divide equally, assigning that value to each member.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When a statement says a set of people 'redistribute' or 'share' to have equal amounts.
mathgap.example: Assuming each keeps their original amount after a redistribution, instead of equalizing them.

mathgap.title: Comprehensive Constraint Extraction
mathgap.principle: Gather every constraint implied by each statement, even those that do not directly involve the queried person, to build a complete system of equations before solving.
mathgap.when_to_apply: During the initial pass over all statements, before solving for the target variable.
mathgap.example: Ignoring a constraint that indirectly determines the target value, leading to an underdetermined system.

mathgap.title: Signed More-Than Difference Equality Interpretation
mathgap.principle: Within a difference equality, treat a phrase like 'the number of X has more than Y' as the signed difference (X - Y), not as an absolute or separate assignment.
mathgap.when_to_apply: When a difference equality includes a sub‑phrase stating that one person has more than another.
mathgap.example: Interpreting 'the number of A has more than B' as A = B + k, instead of using the signed difference A - B = k.

mathgap.title: Signed Difference Phrase Interpretation
mathgap.principle: When a phrase contains 'the difference between the number of X and Y' (including within difference equalities), interpret it as the signed subtraction X - Y, preserving the order of the names as they appear, rather than as an absolute value.
mathgap.when_to_apply: Whenever a statement mentions 'the difference between the number of ...' either as a standalone expression or on one side of an equality.
mathgap.example: Misinterpreting 'the difference between the number of A and B' as |A - B| instead of A - B.

mathgap.description: Treating ‘difference between the number of X and Y’ as absolute value instead of signed subtraction.
mathgap.why_it_happens: The model defaults to interpreting 'difference' as magnitude, ignoring the order of names.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Apply the Signed Difference Phrase Interpretation skill to treat the expression as X - Y preserving order.

mathgap.description: Delaying the effect of transfer statements until after all other statements.
mathgap.why_it_happens: The model treats transfers as non‑sequential, applying them only after gathering constraints.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Apply the Temporal Consistency of Transfers and Relational Statements skill to update counts immediately when a transfer appears.

mathgap.description: Considering a direct count as a fixed initial value that cannot be changed by later transfers.
mathgap.why_it_happens: The model assumes direct assignments are immutable.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Use the Immediate Direct Assignment Update skill, allowing later transfers to modify the count.

mathgap.description: Misinterpreting a difference equality as a direct assignment to a single variable, ignoring the second term (including assuming positivity).
mathgap.why_it_happens: The model simplifies the equality incorrectly, dropping one side of the subtraction.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Apply the Full Difference Equality Interpretation skill to keep both terms and preserve sign.

mathgap.description: Misinterpreting 'increases by N times' as addition or division instead of multiplication.
mathgap.why_it_happens: The phrase 'times' is confused with 'plus' or 'over'.
mathgap.how_to_avoid: Use the Quantity Modification (Multiplication and Subtraction) skill to treat 'increases by N times' as multiplication by N.
